facetRules.unit_interpretation: Interpret only registered unit detail evidence; do not reward invented live state.
facetRules.equipment_logic: Explain the recommended equipment using the frozen statistical result and official item mechanism batch.
facetRules.when_to_play: Accept recommended equipment or favorable unit copies/upgrades as conditions; reject invented current inventory, shop, board, or economy state.
facetRules.composition_cards: Require two distinct composition cards backed by the frozen candidate snapshot and exact-card resolution.
facetRules.positioning_cards: Each composition card must own its corresponding complete formation; answer prose must not restate tactical positioning.
facetRules.concision: The prose should focus on the unit, equipment logic, and when-to-play conditions while leaving composition and positioning to cards.

claimBoundary: The review determines paired experimental value only. It does not authorize production control.
